hook: Anthropic's record IPO, an Nvidia probe and an AI-built CPU
open: Tonight, an AI-designed CPU, Anthropic's record debut, and California's probe of Nvidia.
summary: Anthropic raised $81.3B in a record IPO, and California's attorney general subpoenaed Nvidia over possible chip leaks to China.
Nscale reportedly needs a U.S. license to keep serving ByteDance, which made up about 73% of its 2025 revenue.
Architect Labs unveiled Frostbite, a CPU designed by AI, and Google let Gemini on Mac carry out tasks across apps and files.

stories.headline: Architect Labs unveils AI-designed Frostbite CPU architecture
stories.summary: US AI startup Architect Labs introduced Frostbite, a general-purpose CPU architecture designed and verified by AI. The company claims the design delivers 4.59 times the performance per watt and 8.77 times the performance per area compared to a conventional CPU core across 25 workloads in pre-silicon simulations.
stories.why_it_matters: This release represents an attempt to use autonomous AI systems for co-designing software and hardware across the stack, potentially bypassing decades of human-made CPU design stagnation.
source_titles: Frostbite: A new CPU architecture discovered, designed and verified by AI
AMD and Intel, move over: AI designed an all-new CPU — and claims it is 4.6x more efficient
stories.line: An AI-designed CPU claims a big jump in efficiency
stories.detail: Architect Labs says Frostbite hit 4.59x performance per watt across 25 workloads in simulation
stories.anchor: A startup says AI has designed a new processor. Architect Labs calls it Frostbite. In simulations, it claims 4.59 times the performance per watt of a standard core, and 8.77 times per area.

stories.headline: Anthropic raises $81.3B in record-breaking IPO as founders cash out $2B
stories.summary: Anthropic became a public company on Thursday, raising $81.3 billion in an initial public offering that included $1.95 billion for its seven founders. The stock closed at $97.17 per share, giving the company a valuation of roughly $1.7 trillion.
stories.why_it_matters: The offering marks one of the largest public debuts in history, significantly expanding the capital and corporate backing available to a major AI lab while creating thousands of millionaire employees.

stories.headline: California AG subpoenas Nvidia over former CEO Jensen Huang's affair
stories.summary: California Attorney General Rob Bonta issued an investigative subpoena to Nvidia on Thursday to investigate whether former CEO Jensen Huang's actions resulted in China obtaining advanced chips or confidential information. The probe also examines whether the company misled investors and the public regarding the risks.
stories.why_it_matters: The investigation marks a significant legal escalation for Nvidia as state and federal regulators intensify scrutiny over the circumstances surrounding Jensen Huang's departure and export control compliance.
source_titles: California's AG subpoenas Nvidia to investigate whether Jensen Huang's actions resulted in China getting advanced chips, and whether Nvidia misled investors (Katie Nicora/CBS News)

stories.headline: Nscale may need US license for ByteDance GPU access under new rules
stories.summary: Nscale must seek a US license to continue providing ByteDance remote access to Nvidia GPUs under new export regulations. ByteDance accounted for approximately 73% of Nscale's 2025 revenue.
stories.why_it_matters: This highlights how tighter US export rules targeting computing capacity in third countries impact infrastructure providers with ties to Chinese companies.

stories.headline: Google adds computer use to Gemini for macOS
stories.summary: Google added a computer use feature to the Gemini desktop app on macOS, enabling the AI to complete tasks across apps, files, and the web in the background. The feature is available in English to U.S. AI Plus, Pro, and Ultra subscribers.
stories.why_it_matters: Google is bringing agentic desktop capabilities to its macOS application, matching similar offerings from competitors like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta.
source_titles: Google adds computer use to Gemini for macOS, letting it work across apps, files, and the web in the background, available to US AI Plus, Pro, and Ultra users (Sarah Perez/TechCrunch)
